target_customer: Latin American tech companies that want to embed bank accounts, cards, payments and lending in their products
problem: Launching a financial product in Latin America requires licenses, bank partners and heavy integration work, so non-financial companies cannot offer embedded finance easily.
business_model: API and SDK based embedded finance platform, fees per product or transaction (not stated by a source)
product_category: Embedded finance and banking as a service for Latin America

founders.name: Alejandro Pozo
previous_startups: A small business in LatAm (name not given)
founders.background_notes: YC page: over 8 years in investments and finance covering LatAm.

founders.name: Sebastian Alvarado
education: University of Toronto, computer science with AI specialization
founders.background_notes: YC page says Relay scaled to $20M ARR and 50,000 SMB customers.

exit.reason: Cause not public. PitchBook lists the company as Out of Business and YC lists it as Inactive.

technical_complexity.rationale: Offering accounts, cards, payments and lending through APIs needs integrations with regulated bank partners across several countries, which is hard for three people.

defensibility.rationale: Licensing and bank relationships would be hard to copy and integrations create switching costs, but Valari had no evidenced customers or licenses of its own.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: CB Insights lists Prometeo, founded 2018 in Montevideo, as a comparison company, but the page is undated. No source shows what incumbents did against Valari.

market_need_then: Descubre and Finovate coverage describe strong interest in embedded finance in LatAm, but none of the dated sources found are from the 2022 batch period, so demand at founding is only inferred from the thesis.

branding.domain_note: Used valari.co (not .com); no history found. The site returned HTTP 503 when fetched.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission style copy about democratizing access to financial services in LatAm

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community material about the brand was found, and the name resembles other fintech and game names.

outcome_analysis: Valari joined YC Winter 2022 with three people and raised roughly half a million dollars, per databases, followed by a small Mercury Raise Seed round in late 2022. PitchBook later marked it Out of Business and YC marks it Inactive, but no shutdown announcement or founder post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public. The 2023 retrenching in LatAm fintech is context only, since no source ties it to Valari.
notes: Funding rests on databases only: VCBacked says $500K pre-seed March 2022, PitchBook says a $500K accelerator round January 2022, CB Insights says $600K over 3 rounds with a seed on 2022-10-07. Latka reports $440K revenue and no outside funding, which conflicts. The seed amount is unknown. No dated competitor source found, so the list is empty; Spayr appears as an undated alternative on Shyft.
